sources.label: Thailand Project Document Controller and Admin salary comparables

packages.title: Supplier information and design-input register
packages.scope: One coordination pack per system. Includes supplier data and interface inputs, excluding priced OEM authorship and survey attendance.

packages.title: Master VDRL, numbering and issue setup
packages.scope: Project register and submission workflow.

packages.title: Production baseline and procurement registers
packages.scope: One project pack with schedule, bought-out items and contacts.

packages.title: Manuals index
packages.scope: Initial project index; actual OEM manuals are inputs.

packages.title: Kick-off agenda and minutes
packages.reference: A08 within one week of meeting
packages.scope: Allowance assumes kick-off inside the early window.

packages.title: Engineering studies
packages.scope: One pricing unit per named study. B01 used as index. Confirm applicability and supplier inputs.

packages.title: VHF Radio FDS
packages.scope: One VHF functional specification with cross-references to common interfaces.

packages.title: Site/building layout and cable routing
packages.scope: 19 identifiable site/building drawing units for planning. B03 parent is an index. Confirm actual sheet splits.

packages.title: Block and wiring diagrams
packages.scope: 20 named drawings/scope units. B04 parent is an index. Shared drawings are costed once.

packages.title: Typical installation and aerial drawings
packages.scope: One typical installation set and one aerial/tower set each for APF and ACP. OEM tower scope requires reconciliation.

packages.title: System technical data and schedules
packages.scope: One coordinated system bundle for utility, weight, equipment, operation, termination, calculations, heat and nameplate data as applicable. Reuse B02/B01 content. Collect OEM brochures and material data as inputs.

packages.title: Quality basis and test acceptance plan
packages.scope: One master quality/ITP plan with package annexes. OEM QMS certificate is collected and checked.

packages.title: Periodic reports, minutes and registers
packages.scope: Eight four-week cycles budgeted over eight months. Final partial-cycle reporting is subject to the agreed programme.

packages.title: Review response and reissue
packages.scope: One allowance per 75 early planning units. Includes one review/reissue cycle. Actual review cycles and extra submissions remain OPEN.

packages.title: Factory and site test procedures
packages.reference: C04/C07 T−2; IFAT per MR App 1.0 §2.0(f)
packages.scope: Budget 4 FAT + 2 IFAT campaign packs and 4 SAT site packs across 2 SAT campaigns. Verify supplier and site programme.

packages.title: Factory and site consolidated reports
packages.scope: Same planning events as procedures. Cost includes cover, integration and sign-off. Signed evidence is tracked separately below.

packages.title: Named FAT evidence sections
packages.scope: One evidence section allowance per named FAT code; report assembly above covers the shared pack.

packages.title: Named SAT evidence sections
packages.scope: One evidence section allowance per named SAT code. Verify C08.02 native MDR title and D review code with customer.

packages.title: Shipment document and inspection release packs
packages.scope: Four shipment packs, including shipping/packing records and review of OEM certificates, release notes and concessions. Consolidate C15 evidence. Broker/forwarder cost is separate.

packages.title: Import / permit dossier verification
packages.scope: Two applications assumed. Labour only. Start against actual permit lead times; charges and sign-off remain separate.

packages.title: Installation and commissioning procedures
packages.scope: One common method with system annexes; confirm issue milestones and existing execution owner.

packages.title: Commissioning and operating spare lists
packages.scope: One system data review per planning unit. Lists and spare purchases have separate scope.

packages.title: Installation and O&M dossier inputs
packages.scope: One system input pack feeding the three controlled dossier families. OEM manuals collected and checked. Verify despatch versions.

packages.title: As-built redlines and final system record
packages.scope: Update controlled design from field redlines and verify TAGs, serials and configurations. Closeout compilation below excludes authoring.

packages.title: Final project dossier issue and archive
packages.reference: MR Appendix 3 printed p.36 / final submissions
packages.scope: Index, approval, native files, final issue and archive. Confirm dossier copies, Mechanical Dossier applicability and separate client releases.

packages.title: Early Buildings separate issue allowance
packages.reference: MR App 1.0 phased handover / B03 series
packages.scope: Incremental split/reissue only. Transfer to early window if actual programme requires.

packages.title: Invoice milestones and administrative closeout
packages.scope: Seven milestone sets as tender planning assumption plus commercial closeout. Rebase to signed payment schedule.
